description: Unfriend an existing mutually connected accountId, immediately revoking direct messaging and contacts-only profile access between both accounts. Requires a registered local identity. Unlike socialwtf_reject_connection (which declines a pending inbound request) or socialwtf_block_user (which also blocks future contact requests), this cleanly ends an active friendship.

accountId.description: Connected friend's internal SocialWTF account ID (e.g. 'acc_01J...') from socialwtf_list_connections.

name: socialwtf_remove_connection

success.description: True when the friendship was removed.

title: Remove Mutual Friend Connection
